etsy.title: Elf Family Shirts PNG Bundle, 24 Matching Christmas Elf Roles, Family Christmas Shirt Design, Sublimation DTF PNG, Head Elf, Cookie Taster
etsy.description:
Every family has a Cookie Taster Elf. 🎄 Now everyone gets their own matching shirt.

24 original elf role designs with a cute elf hat illustration, ready for matching family Christmas shirts, mugs and gifts.

✨ ROLES INCLUDED (24)
Baby, Baking, Bossy, Cocoa, Coffee, Cookie Taster, Cozy, Dancing, Grumpy, Head, Hungry, Jolly, Late, Lazy, Loud, Messy, Sassy, Selfie, Shopping, Silly, Sleepy, Snacky, Sparkly, Wrapping

📁 WHAT YOU GET
• 1 ZIP file with 24 PNG files
• 3000 x 3600 px, 300 DPI, transparent background
• Cream outline around the text, so it also reads well on colored shirts

🖨 USE IT FOR
Sublimation on white or light polyester, DTF transfers, print shops, print-then-cut iron-on (Cricut), mugs, tote bags, cards.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colors may look slightly different on screen and on fabric.

LICENSE
Personal use and small business use up to 200 finished items. Do not resell, share or redistribute the digital files. Not affiliated with any elf doll brand.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
